messages:
marie (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're publishing handbook updates today at 3pm PT. Key additions: new sabbatical policy section, clarified dependent care reimbursement, and an updated PTO accrual example. Action items: 1) Everyone must complete the 'Handbook update ack' in Workday (takes <2 min). 2) Complete the short compliance micro-course 'Handbook changes — 2026 Q1' by Fri 04/10. Managers: please update the tracking sheet with your team's acknowledgements.

sanjay (HRBP): Do contractors need to complete the ack/course?

marie (People Ops): Contractors are excluded from mandatory Workday ack; we still recommend they read. Only employees must complete the course for compliance records. I'll add a contractor column in the tracker.

ali (Recruiter): Can I get a canned message for onboarding emails so new hires see this change?

marie (People Ops): Sure — use below and paste into offer/onboarding threads:
```
Subject: Quick: Updated Employee Handbook — please review
Hi <Name>,
We've updated our employee handbook (effective 2026-04-01) — please review the changes and complete the 'Handbook update ack' in Workday within 7 days. Link: https://redwood.okta.workday/handbook-update
Thanks,
Ali on behalf of People Ops
```

sanjay (HRBP): Retroactive date question — if someone was on unpaid leave between Mar 1–Mar 31, do we require they complete the course?

dana (Legal): Not retroactive. Policy effective date is 2026-04-01; compliance requirement applies from that date forward. If it's needed for an incident, we'll handle case-by-case. No legal requirement to chase former employees.

marie (People Ops): Tracker link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A2B3C4D/edit — managers, please update column "Ack status" by EOD Fri 04/10. Use these statuses: "Acked", "In progress", "Exempt (contractor)", "N/A". If you need bulk upload, ping me.

lms-bot: Reminder — 'Handbook changes — 2026 Q1' assigned to 234 users. Due by 2026-04-10. https://lms.redwood.example/courses/handbook-2026Q1

ali (Recruiter): Thx — I'll paste the canned text into all active offers this afternoon.

marie (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If any manager needs a CSV export of their team status, DM me. :thumbsup:

sanjay (HRBP): Got it. I'll nudge two managers who are low on completion with a one-line ping.

dana (Legal): FYI — I'll run a short Q&A doc (2 Qs) for the training page to address common legal concerns.

marie (People Ops): Perfect. Closing the loop: publish at 3pm PT, automated email from Workday goes out at 3:05pm, manual reminder on Tue. Anything else?

ali (Recruiter): All good from recruiting. :white_check_mark:

sanjay (HRBP): All set. :eyes:

marie (People Ops): Great — thanks team.
